How Rules Work

  • •Priority: Rules are evaluated in order of priority (highest first). The first matching rule categorizes the transaction.
  • •Regex: Use regular expressions to match transaction descriptions. Patterns are case-insensitive.
  • •Amount filters: Optionally restrict rules to specific amount ranges or directions (debit/credit).
  • •Testing: Use the test button to preview which sample transactions your rule would match.
  • •Reordering: Use the arrow buttons to change rule priority. Higher priority rules appear first.
